controlContracts.label: Replay
controlContracts.description: Reconstruct inputs and ordered evidence without re-running side effects.
controlContracts.failure: Fails closed when inputs, adapter version, or evidence hashes are incomplete.

controlContracts.label: Suspend
controlContracts.description: Request a cooperative pause at the next declared safe checkpoint.
controlContracts.failure: Times out to unknown state; never claims suspension without adapter acknowledgement.

controlContracts.label: Terminate
controlContracts.description: Request bounded shutdown through an explicitly authorized adapter.
controlContracts.failure: Escalates to an operator when graceful shutdown is unconfirmed; no blind process kill.
